what: The hero opens as a thin slit in the screen center (a window with 48% cut from top and bottom and 46% from left and right) over 1s power4.out, then spreads to fill the screen over 2s power4.inOut. Meanwhile the image inside settles from 1.4x to 1.2x (1s) and 1x (2s), and the large name letters slide in from 1em to the right one at a time at .01s intervals along with the spread — when fully open, fx:done

options.open: Length of the full-screen unfold (s), default 2 — it makes people wait, so shorten it for frequently opened screens
options.zoom: Initial image scale, default 1.4 (shrinks to 1.2 during gaps, then to 1)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Panel to be cut open (child) — if absent, cut the element itself
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: (If any) Image that sinks inside the panel
options.[data-fx-part=title]: (If present) big letters that slide in one by one — words are wrapped as chunks so line breaks never split a word
options.fx:done: When fully open, the element emits this event (e.g. to release the scroll lock)

use: Your name here
note: The original holds scrolling until this intro ends (.8s before) — the user resumes it on fx:done

from.where: index.html .e-hero (intro) — original hero: [data-scene] scale 1.4→1.2 1s power4.out @0 → 1 2s power4.inOut @1, [data-scene-wrapper] clip inset(100%)→inset(48% 46% 48% 46%) 1s power4.out @0 → inset(0) 2s power4.inOut @1, characters x 1em 2s power4.inOut stagger .01 @1
